name: Utkarsh Small Finance Bank Ltd
title: Utkarsh Small Finance Bank Ltd - 543942 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Legacy MFI stress peaking: Q4 fresh slippages fell to ~INR170 crores from ~INR710 crores a year earlier and GNPA 7.7%, but FY27 credit cost guided at ~3% with no capital-cycle supply signal.

triggers.label: Fresh slippages ~INR170 cr vs ~INR710 cr
triggers.quote: Fresh NPA slippages (net of recoveries and upgradations) reduced to ~INR170 crores in quarter 4 of FY '26 against ~INR710 crores in the quarter 4 of FY '25.

triggers.label: JLG disbursements up 58% QoQ
triggers.quote: JLG disbursements grew 58% quarter-on-quarter and 2% year-on-year, while non-JLG disbursements grew 41% quarter-on-quarter and 51% year-on-year.

triggers.label: Cost of funds 8.3% → 7.9% YoY
triggers.quote: moving from 8.3% in quarter 4 FY '25 to 8.1% in quarter 3 FY '26 and to 7.9% in quarter 4 FY '26.

triggers.label: Credit cost FY27 ~3% guided
triggers.quote: we will still stick to the fact that it will be around 3% for FY '27 to 2% to 2.5% in FY '28.

triggers.label: Still only 70% disbursal capacity
triggers.quote: we are only at a 70% optimum capacity of disbursal

guidance.quote: it will be around 3% for FY '27 to 2% to 2.5% in FY '28.
In the coming years, we are aiming for loan book growth of 25% to 30%
with secured lending comprising around 55% of the portfolio
we should be back to 15% ROE
idea is to reach below 1% by FY '28
We expect cost of funds to reduce further as repricing continues to take effect.

prior_guidance_check.quote: we will still stick to the fact that it will be around 3% for FY '27 to 2% to 2.5% in FY '28.

red_flags.label: Net loss INR188 cr in Q4 on legacy provisioning
red_flags.quote: We reported a net loss of INR188 crores for the quarter, driven by provisioning for legacy stress.

red_flags.label: Non-MFI slippages still ~4% with Wheels problem
red_flags.quote: Wheels has been one of the problem area for us in the past

red_flags.label: Management ROE and NPA targets reiterated despite loss
red_flags.quote: we are there. We'll exit FY '28 above 15% ROE.

evasions.quote: No. Even that has not been done by us.
it doesn't apply to us in terms of statute requirement.
Mahesh, so I may not have exact numbers
